notes.title: THE FINAL ASSETFLIP ATTORNEY COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT
notes.content:

Never did I think it would result in gaining fan art (and some bangers aswell)

ALSO, the results of the popularity poll so as voted by you lot the ranking of the character goes as following:
1. MAIN CHARACTER YOU
2. BIG MAN MR MONKEY
3. EVERYONES FAVOURITE SCREAMING CAT MAXWELL
4. FRY EATER TERRY
5. BRITISH CHAP FLUDGE
6. TV SKIN KRANE
8. JUDGE BARRY
9. SUS ROBOT TAGGER
10. MY GOAT SINNER

very cool and again thank you for all the kind words in the reviews 

as the era of assetflip closes we are only just getting started, new game soon
